Alger, 21 octobre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, October 21, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Mobile operator Djezzy is introducing Confy, a video conferencing application entirely designed in Algeria targeting professional organizations.
Déploiement d'une solution collaborative: Deployment of a national collaborative solution
Développée en collaboration avec la star: Developed in collaboration with the start-up BortoCall, the Confy platform allows users to organize virtual meetings hosting up to three hundred participants. The tool integrates several features tailored to professional needs, including screen sharing, collaborative annotation, and session recording, while dynamically adjusting video quality to the available connection.
Les organisations bénéficient de formule: Organizations benefit from flexible pricing plans based on their size and requirements. An administration space is also provided to IT managers to control users, access, and permissions in compliance with each entity's internal policies. Subscriptions are accessible via the Djezzy Cloud Marketplace.
La sécurité constitue un axe central de: Security is a central focus of this innovation, relying on end-to-end encryption. All traffic and data are hosted and processed locally on the operator's sovereign cloud infrastructure.
Cette nouveauté arrive après la mise en: This new release comes after the launch, in early October, of the Relay collaborative messaging solution. BortoCall co-founders Bilal Sefsaf and Mohamed Amine Smida emphasize that this project materializes a shared vision to equip national institutions with local technological tools ensuring data sovereignty. The company's CEO, Boumediene Senouci, welcomed this initiative, which demonstrates the commitment to empowering local youth.
